comparisonPolicy.temporaryRoots: Each root becomes <workspace> in result strings.
comparisonPolicy.fullOutputNames: Random names mapped by references; exact file hashes/sizes/modes/safe-name checks compared.
comparisonPolicy.duration: Nonnegative numeric wall_time_seconds retained raw; excluded from value equality.
comparisonPolicy.images: Original payloads exact bytes; selected reencoded images compare decoded RGBA dimensions/pixels; raw payloads retained. MIME, notes, structured results and failures remain exact.
comparisonPolicy.jpegCodecs: Only named calibrated cases may use the explicit JPEG envelope. Strict hashes/differences remain recorded. Quantization, sampling, fidelity and every non-pixel contract are checked; see setup.jpegComparison.
comparisonPolicy.safetyExclusions: Named image allocation limits and reviewed atomic/private-mutation differences remain failed strict comparisons. Only complete frozen expected observations may be excluded; actual outputs, ownership and filesystem differences are retained. They never increase passed/strictPassed.
comparisonPolicy.updates: Raw complete updates retained; initial/final snapshots compared. Timing/chunk count not asserted identical.
comparisonPolicy.filesystem: Exact content hashes, short-file bytes, kinds, modes, uid/gid, link targets/peers and inode-preservation flags. No mtime/ctime/absolute inode equality.

sourceOnlyOrderDifference.classification: Complete encounter-order variation between two actual pinned runs; failed strict comparison retained, no product used or comparator relaxed.
